# External code contributions are currently closed

ITECOB Inc. is not currently accepting external code or other copyrightable contributions for incorporation into goodLAC.

Please do not use a pull request to submit code for merge at this time. A code pull request may be closed without review or merge.

You may instead:

- open a bug report;
- open a feature request;
- describe an idea or reproducible technical observation; or
- use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting for undisclosed security issues.

ITECOB Inc. may independently investigate, design, or implement ideas raised through those channels.

The contributor process will be updated before external code contributions are opened.
